question: Which Batsmen has the highest batting average against Australia in T20 history?
query: SELECT p.player_name FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.striker_id WHERE d.bowling_team = 'Australia' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(player_out_id) FROM Deliveries d2 WHERE d2.player_out_id = p.player_id AND d2.bowling_team = 'Australia'), 0)) DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: Which Batsmen has the highest batting average against Australia in T20 history?
question_hindi: टी20 इतिहास में ऑस्ट्रेलिया के खिलाफ सबसे अधिक बल्लेबाजी औसत किस बल्लेबाज़ का है?

question: Across all T20 World Cup editions, which team has used the most bowlers in a single innings and did that strategy result in a win or loss?
query: SELECT d.bowling_team, COUNT(DISTINCT d.bowler_id) AS total_bowlers_used, CASE WHEN d.bowling_team = m.match_winner THEN 'Win' WHEN m.match_winner IS NULL AND m.result_type IN ('tie', 'no result') THEN 'Tie/No Result' ELSE 'Loss' END AS match_result FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team, m.match_winner, m.result_type ORDER BY total_bowlers_used DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: Across all T20 World Cup editions, which team has used the most bowlers in a single innings and did that strategy result in a win or loss?

question: Which bowler has the best economy rate in overs 17-20 across all T20 World Cups, with a minimum of 100 balls bowled in that phase?
query: SELECT p.player_name FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id WHERE d.over_number BETWEEN 17 AND 20 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 100 ORDER BY (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) ASC LIMIT 1;
question_english: Which bowler has the best economy rate in overs 17-20 across all T20 World Cups, with a minimum of 100 balls bowled in that phase?

question: In T20I ,who has the best average among bowlers with 10+ wickets, and what is their economy and strike rate?
query: SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS bowling_average, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS economy_rate, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS strike_rate FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 10 ORDER BY bowling_average ASC LIMIT 1;
question_english: Who has the best average among bowlers with 10+ wickets, and what is their economy and strike rate?

question_telugu: 10+ వికెట్లు సంపాదించిన బౌలర్లలో ఎవరి దగ్గర అన్నిటికన్నా మంచి ఆవెరేజ్ ఉన్నది? వాళ్ళ ఎకానమీ మరియు స్ట్రైక్ రేట్ ఏమిటి?

question: Which fielder has the most dismissals in knockout stage matches, and give dismissals per innings as well?
query: SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS total_dismissals, (COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m2 ON pim.match_id = m2.match_id WHERE pim.player_id = p.player_id AND m2.stage <> 'Group')) AS dismissals_per_innings FROM Players p JOIN FielderDismissals fd ON p.player_id = fd.fielder_id JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.stage <> 'Group' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY total_dismissals DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: Which fielder has the most dismissals in knockout stage matches, and give dismissals per innings as well?

question: In T20 history list the top two teams in terms of percentage of matches won ,also give the percentages.
query: WITH TeamMatches AS (SELECT team1 AS team, match_id, match_winner FROM Matches UNION ALL SELECT team2 AS team, match_id, match_winner FROM Matches) SELECT team, (SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(match_id)) AS win_percentage FROM TeamMatches GROUP BY team ORDER BY win_percentage DESC LIMIT 2;

question: For Hetmyer, Farhan, and Kishan — what percentage of their total runs came from boundaries in T-20 season 2026?

question: Calculate non-boundary runs for Kusal Mendis, Pathum Nissanka, and Aiden Markram. Who scored most between the wickets in T-20 season 2026?

question: Name the two players who have exactly 4 ducks (0s), played for the same country.
query: WITH PlayerScores AS (SELECT d.match_id, d.striker_id, d.batting_team, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, MAX(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.striker_id, d.batting_team), DuckCounts AS (SELECT striker_id, batting_team, COUNT(match_id) AS ducks FROM PlayerScores WHERE runs = 0 AND is_out = 1 GROUP BY striker_id, batting_team HAVING ducks = 4) SELECT p1.player_name, p2.player_name FROM DuckCounts d1 JOIN DuckCounts d2 ON d1.batting_team = d2.batting_team AND d1.striker_id < d2.striker_id JOIN Players p1 ON d1.striker_id = p1.player_id JOIN Players p2 ON d2.striker_id = p2.player_id LIMIT 1;
question_english: Name the two players who have exactly 4 ducks (0s), played for the same country.
question_hindi: उन दो खिलाड़ियों के नाम बताइए जिनके ठीक 4 डक (0) हैं और जो एक ही देश के लिए खेले।
question_punjabi: ਉਹ ਦੋ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਦੱਸੋ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਠੀਕ 4 ਡੱਕ (0) ਹਨ ਅਤੇ ਉਹ ਇੱਕੋ ਦੇਸ਼ ਲਈ ਖੇਡਦੇ ਹਨ।
question_telugu: ఏ రెండు క్రీడాకార్ల దగ్గర సరిగ్గా 4 సున్నాలు ఉన్నాయి? వాళ్ళు ఒకే దేశం కోసం ఆడారు.

question: Which player has the highest strike rate (SR) among all those with exactly 3 ducks, and what is that SR?
query: WITH PlayerInnings AS (SELECT match_id, striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, striker_id), PlayerStats AS (SELECT striker_id, SUM(CASE WHEN runs = 0 AND is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS duck_count, SUM(total_runs) AS career_runs, SUM(balls_faced) AS career_balls FROM PlayerInnings GROUP BY striker_id) SELECT p.player_name, (ps.career_runs * 100.0 / ps.career_balls) AS strike_rate FROM PlayerStats ps JOIN Players p ON ps.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE ps.duck_count = 3 AND ps.career_balls > 0 ORDER BY strike_rate DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: Which player has the highest strike rate (SR) among all those with exactly 3 ducks, and what is that SR?
question_hindi: ठीक 3 डक वाले सभी खिलाड़ियों में सबसे अधिक स्ट्राइक रेट (SR) किस खिलाड़ी का है, और वह SR क्या है?
question_punjabi: ਠੀਕ 3 ਡੱਕ ਵਾਲੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਸਦੀ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਸਟ੍ਰਾਈਕ ਰੇਟ (SR) ਹੈ, ਅਤੇ ਉਹ SR ਕੀ ਹੈ?
question_telugu: సరిగ్గా 3 డక్కులు ఉన్ను క్రీడాకార్లలో అన్నిటికన్నా మంచి స్ట్రైక్ రేట్ ఎవరిది? ఆ స్ట్రైక్ రేట్ ఏమిటి?

question: Name the team that conceded the most extras, state the ground, opposition, and how many were wides.

question_english: Name the team that conceded the most extras, state the ground, opposition, and how many were wides.

question: Among all entries with exactly 19 extras, which team had the highest run rate, and what was their score?
query: SELECT d.batting_team, ((SUM(d.runs_scored) + SUM(d.extra_runs)) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS run_rate, (SUM(d.runs_scored) + SUM(d.extra_runs)) AS total_score FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team HAVING SUM(d.extra_runs) = 19 ORDER BY run_rate DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: Among all entries with exactly 19 extras, which team had the highest run rate, and what was their score?

question: Among players with over 800 runs and exactly 3 ducks, who has the lower strike rate — and by how much?
query: WITH InningsStats AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs_in_innings, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_in_innings, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id), PlayerStats AS (SELECT striker_id, SUM(runs_in_innings) AS total_runs, SUM(balls_in_innings) AS total_balls, SUM(CASE WHEN runs_in_innings = 0 AND is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ducks FROM InningsStats GROUP BY striker_id) SELECT p.player_name, (ps.total_runs * 100.0 / ps.total_balls) AS lowest_strike_rate FROM PlayerStats ps JOIN Players p ON ps.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE ps.total_runs > 800 AND ps.ducks = 3 ORDER BY lowest_strike_rate ASC LIMIT 2;
question_english: Among players with over 800 runs and exactly 3 ducks, who has the lower strike rate — and by how much?
question_hindi: 800 से अधिक रन और ठीक 3 डक वाले खिलाड़ियों में किसका स्ट्राइक रेट कम है — और कितना कम है?

question: In the ICC Men's T20 World Cup , which team gave away 19 extras while bowling out the opposition for just 68 runs, and who was the opposition?

question: In the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026, which bowler took 4 wickets while conceding just 7 runs, against which opposition, and what was his economy rate?
query: SELECT p.player_name, d.batting_team AS opposition, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS economy_rate FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name, d.match_id, d.batting_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 4 AND SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) = 7;

question: Which Australian bowler appeared in the T20 World Cup 2026 best bowling figures list twice, name his two opponents and combined wickets across both performances
query: WITH BowlerStats AS (SELECT p.player_name, d.bowler_id, d.batting_team AS opposition, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id WHERE d.bowling_team = 'Australia' AND m.season = '2026' GROUP BY p.player_name, d.bowler_id, d.match_id, d.batting_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4) SELECT player_name, GROUP_CONCAT(opposition, ' and ') AS opponents, SUM(wickets) AS combined_wickets FROM BowlerStats GROUP BY player_name, bowler_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 2;

question: Which two bowlers took 4 wickets each against India in T20 World Cup 2026 — name both, their countries, and which was more economical and by how much.
query: WITH BowlerStats AS (SELECT p.player_name, d.bowling_team AS country, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS economy_rate FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' AND d.batting_team = 'India' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name, d.match_id, d.bowling_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 4) SELECT b1.player_name AS bowler1, b1.country AS country1, b2.player_name AS bowler2, b2.country AS country2, CASE WHEN b1.economy_rate < b2.economy_rate THEN b1.player_name ELSE b2.player_name END AS more_economical, ABS(b1.economy_rate - b2.economy_rate) AS economy_diff FROM BowlerStats b1 JOIN BowlerStats b2 ON b1.player_name < b2.player_name LIMIT 1;

question: In T20 World Cup history, which South African fielder has the highest Ct/Inn ratio among all players with 16+ catches,  total catches, and Maximum catches in a single innings?
query: WITH FieldingInnings AS (SELECT pim.player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS catches_in_innings FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.team_name = d.bowling_team LEFT JOIN FielderDismissals fd ON d.delivery_id = fd.delivery_id AND fd.fielder_id = pim.player_id WHERE pim.team_name = 'South Africa' GROUP BY pim.player_id, d.match_id, d.inning), FielderStats AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(catches_in_innings) AS total_catches, COUNT(match_id) AS innings_fielded, MAX(catches_in_innings) AS max_catches_in_inning FROM FieldingInnings GROUP BY player_id) SELECT p.player_name AS fielder, fs.total_catches, fs.innings_fielded, ROUND(CAST(fs.total_catches AS FLOAT) / fs.innings_fielded, 3) AS ct_inn_ratio, fs.max_catches_in_inning FROM FielderStats fs JOIN Players p ON fs.player_id = p.player_id WHERE fs.total_catches >= 16 ORDER BY ct_inn_ratio DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: In T20 World Cup history, which South African fielder has the highest Ct/Inn ratio among all players with 16+ catches,  total catches, and Maximum catches in a single innings?
question_hindi: टी20 विश्व कप इतिहास में, 16 या उससे अधिक कैच वाले खिलाड़ियों में किस दक्षिण अफ्रीकी फील्डर का Ct/Inn अनुपात सबसे अधिक है, साथ ही कुल कैच और एक पारी में सर्वाधिक कैच भी बताइए?
question_punjabi: T20 ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ, 16 ਜਾਂ ਵੱਧ ਕੈਚਾਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਸ ਦੱਖਣੀ ਅਫ਼ਰੀਕੀ ਫ਼ੀਲਡਰ ਦੀ Ct/Inn ਅਨੁਪਾਤ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਹੈ, ਕੁੱਲ ਕੈਚ ਅਤੇ ਇੱਕੋ ਪਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੱਧ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਕੈਚ ਵੀ ਦੱਸੋ?
question_telugu: T20 వరల్డ్ కప్పు ఇతిహాసలో కనీసం 16 క్యాచులు పట్టిన సౌత్ ఆఫ్రికా ఫీల్డర్లలో ఒక మ్యాచ్కు ఎక్కువ క్యాచులు పట్టే (Ct/Inn ఎక్కువగా ఉన్న) క్రీడాకారుడు ఎవరు? అతని మొత్తం క్యాచులు మరియు ఒక ఇన్నింగ్స్లో అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ క్యాచులు రాయండి.

question: Among all players with exactly 14 catches, which has the best Ct/Inn ratio, name all four players with 14 catches, their countries, and rank them by Ct/Inn best to worst.
query: WITH CatchCounts AS (SELECT fd.fielder_id, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS total_catches FROM FielderDismissals fd JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE d.wicket_type IN ('caught', 'caught and bowled') GROUP BY fd.fielder_id HAVING COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) = 14), PlayerStats AS (SELECT player_id, MAX(team_name) AS country, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS innings_played FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id) SELECT p.player_name, ps.country, cc.total_catches, (cc.total_catches * 1.0 / ps.innings_played) AS ct_inn_ratio FROM CatchCounts cc JOIN PlayerStats ps ON cc.fielder_id = ps.player_id JOIN Players p ON cc.fielder_id = p.player_id ORDER BY ct_inn_ratio DESC;
question_english: Among all players with exactly 14 catches, which has the best Ct/Inn ratio, name all four players with 14 catches, their countries, and rank them by Ct/Inn best to worst.
question_hindi: ठीक 14 कैच वाले सभी खिलाड़ियों में किसका Ct/Inn अनुपात सबसे अच्छा है, 14 कैच वाले सभी चार खिलाड़ियों के नाम, उनके देश, और Ct/Inn के आधार पर सर्वश्रेष्ठ से सबसे कम तक रैंकिंग बताइए।
question_punjabi: ਠੀਕ 14 ਕੈਚਾਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਸਦੀ Ct/Inn ਅਨੁਪਾਤ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵਧੀਆ ਹੈ, 14 ਕੈਚਾਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਚਾਰ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਦੇਸ਼, ਅਤੇ Ct/Inn ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵਧੀਆ ਤੋਂ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਮਾੜੇ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੱਸੋ?
question_telugu: సరిగ్గా 14 క్యాచులు ఉన్న క్రీడాకార్లలో ఎవరి దగ్గర అన్నిటికన్నా మంచి Ct/Inn రేషియో ఉన్నది? అన్నీ నలుగురు ఆటగాళ్లు మరియు వాళ్ళ దేశాలు రాయండి. వారిని Ct/Inn రేషియో ప్రకారం ఎక్కువ నుండి తక్కువ వరుసలో అమర్చండి.

question: Name the only West Indian fielder who played fewer than 30 matches yet took 15+ catches, his Ct/Inn ratio, and Maximum wickets in an innings .
query: WITH MatchCatches AS (SELECT fd.fielder_id, d.match_id, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS match_catches FROM FielderDismissals fd JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE d.wicket_type = 'caught' GROUP BY fd.fielder_id, d.match_id) SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(mc.match_catches) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) FROM PlayerInMatch WHERE player_id = mc.fielder_id)) AS ct_inn_ratio, MAX(mc.match_catches) AS max_catches_in_innings FROM MatchCatches mc JOIN Players p ON mc.fielder_id = p.player_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PlayerInMatch pim WHERE pim.player_id = mc.fielder_id AND pim.team_name = 'West Indies') GROUP BY mc.fielder_id, p.player_name HAVING (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) FROM PlayerInMatch WHERE player_id = mc.fielder_id) < 30 AND SUM(mc.match_catches) >= 15;
question_english: Name the only West Indian fielder who played fewer than 30 matches yet took 15+ catches, his Ct/Inn ratio, and Maximum wickets in an innings .
question_hindi: 30 से कम मैच खेलने के बावजूद 15 या उससे अधिक कैच लेने वाला एकमात्र वेस्ट इंडियन फील्डर कौन है, उसका Ct/Inn अनुपात और एक पारी में अधिकतम विकेट क्या हैं?
question_punjabi: ਉਸ ਇੱਕ ਮਾਤਰ West Indies ਫ਼ੀਲਡਰ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਦੱਸੋ ਜਿਸਨੇ 30 ਤੋਂ ਘੱਟ ਮੈਚ ਖੇਡੇ ਪਰ 15 ਜਾਂ ਵੱਧ ਕੈਚ ਲਏ, ਉਸਦੀ Ct/Inn ਅਨੁਪਾਤ ਅਤੇ ਇੱਕ ਪਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੱਧ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਵੀ ਦੱਸੋ?
question_telugu: ఏ వెస్ట్ ఇండీస్ ఫీల్డర్ 30 కన్నా తక్కువ మ్యాచులు ఆడిన సరే 15 కన్నా ఎక్కువ క్యాచులు పట్టుకున్నాడు? అతన Ct/Inn రేషియో మరియు ఒక ఇన్నింగ్స్లో అతను పట్టిన అత్యధిక క్యాచుల సంఖ్యను రాయండి.

question: In T20 history name all the teams which won a match with a margin of 1 run , give the opposing team as well as the target score.
query: SELECT m.match_winner AS winning_team, CASE WHEN m.team1 = m.match_winner THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opposing_team, (SELECT SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) + 1 FROM Deliveries d WHERE d.match_id = m.match_id AND d.inning = 1) AS target_score FROM Matches m WHERE m.result_margin = 1 AND m.result_type = 'runs';
question_english: Name all the teams which won a match with a margin of 1 run , give the opposing team as well as the target score.
question_hindi: उन सभी टीमों के नाम बताइए जिन्होंने 1 रन के अंतर से मैच जीता, साथ में विपक्षी टीम और लक्ष्य स्कोर भी दीजिए।
question_punjabi: T20 ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਉਹ ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਦੱਸੋ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ 1 ਰਨ ਦੇ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਨਾਲ ਮੈਚ ਜਿੱਤਿਆ, ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ ਅਤੇ ਟੀਚਾ ਸਕੋਰ ਵੀ ਦੱਸੋ?
question_telugu: ఏ టిములు 1 పరుగు అంచుతో మ్యాచ్ గెలిచారు? వ్యతిరేకమైన టీం మరియు లక్ష్య స్కోర్ రాయండి.

question: In T20 history, excluding the teams with No Results (NR), which team has the worst win-loss record in a single series, and what is their exact record?
query: WITH TeamSeasonStats AS (SELECT m.season, t.team_name, SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner = t.team_name THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins, SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner != t.team_name AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND m.result_type != 'no result' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS losses, SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner IS NULL OR m.result_type = 'no result' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nr_count FROM Matches m JOIN (SELECT match_id, team1 AS team_name FROM Matches UNION ALL SELECT match_id, team2 AS team_name FROM Matches) t ON m.match_id = t.match_id GROUP BY m.season, t.team_name) SELECT team_name, season, wins, losses FROM TeamSeasonStats WHERE nr_count = 0 ORDER BY (wins * 1.0 / (wins + losses)) ASC, losses DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: In T20 history, excluding the teams with No Results (NR), which team has the worst win-loss record in a single series, and what is their exact record?
question_hindi: टी20 इतिहास में, नो रिज़ल्ट (NR) वाली टीमों को छोड़कर, किसी एक सीरीज़ में सबसे खराब जीत-हार रिकॉर्ड किस टीम का है, और उसका सटीक रिकॉर्ड क्या है?
question_punjabi: T20 ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ, ਕੋਈ ਨਤੀਜਾ ਨਾ (NR) ਵਾਲੀਆਂ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਛੱਡ ਕੇ, ਕਿਸ ਟੀਮ ਦਾ ਇੱਕੋ ਲੜੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਖਰਾਬ ਜਿੱਤ-ਹਾਰ ਰਿਕਾਰਡ ਹੈ, ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦਾ ਸਹੀ ਰਿਕਾਰਡ ਕੀ ਹੈ?
question_telugu: T20 ఇతిహాసలో రిసల్ట్ లేని (NR) టిములు మినహాయించి ఒక సిరీస్లో ఏ టీం దగ్గర అన్నిటికన్నా తక్కువ గెలుపు ఓటమి రికార్డు ఉన్నది? ఆ రికార్డు ఏమిటి?

question: Name the players who have scored multiple fastest hundreds in T20 World Cups and also tell the number of hundreds?
query: WITH CenturyInnings AS (SELECT match_id, striker_id, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, striker_id HAVING SUM(runs_scored) >= 100) SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(c.match_id) AS number_of_hundreds FROM CenturyInnings c JOIN Players p ON c.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY c.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING COUNT(c.match_id) > 1;
question_english: Name the players who have scored multiple fastest hundreds in T20 World Cups and also tell the number of hundreds?
question_hindi: उन खिलाड़ियों के नाम बताइए जिन्होंने टी20 विश्व कपों में एक से अधिक सबसे तेज़ शतक बनाए हैं, और शतकों की संख्या भी बताइए।
question_punjabi: ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਦੱਸੋ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ T20 ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਈ ਵਾਰ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਤੇਜ਼ ਸੈਂਕੜੇ ਲਗਾਏ ਅਤੇ ਸੈਂਕੜਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਵੀ ਦੱਸੋ?
question_telugu: ఏ క్రీడాకార్లు T20 వరల్డ్ కుప్పుల్లో అనేక వేగవంతమైన శతకాలు కొట్టారు? వాళ్ళు ఎన్ని శతకాలు కొట్టారు?

question: Name the batsmen who scored fastest hundreds against Bangladesh and also report the balls faced by them
query: WITH CenturyInnings AS (SELECT match_id, striker_id, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced FROM Deliveries WHERE bowling_team = 'Bangladesh' GROUP BY match_id, striker_id HAVING SUM(runs_scored) >= 100) SELECT p.player_name, c.balls_faced FROM CenturyInnings c JOIN Players p ON c.striker_id = p.player_id ORDER BY c.balls_faced ASC;
question_english: Name the batsmen who scored fastest hundreds against Bangladesh and also report the balls faced by them

question_punjabi: Bangladesh ਦੇ ਖਿਲਾਫ਼ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਤੇਜ਼ ਸੈਂਕੜਾ ਲਗਾਉਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ਾਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਦੱਸੋ ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਖੇਡੀਆਂ ਗਈਆਂ ਗੇਂਦਾਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਵੀ ਦੱਸੋ?

question: Which match holds the record for the highest run rate, and what is that run rate?
query: SELECT m.team1, m.team2, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS run_rate FROM Matches m JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id GROUP BY m.match_id, m.team1, m.team2 ORDER BY run_rate DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: Which match holds the record for the highest run rate, and what is that run rate?
question_hindi: सबसे ऊंचे रन रेट का रिकॉर्ड किस मैच के नाम है, और वह रन रेट क्या है?

question: Which team has the highest aggregate losses in the shortest matches (by the balls bowled) without ever winning?
query: WITH ShortestMatches AS (SELECT match_id FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ASC LIMIT 15), MatchTeams AS (SELECT m.match_id, m.team1 AS team, m.match_winner FROM Matches m JOIN ShortestMatches sm ON m.match_id = sm.match_id UNION ALL SELECT m.match_id, m.team2 AS team, m.match_winner FROM Matches m JOIN ShortestMatches sm ON m.match_id = sm.match_id) SELECT team, SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner != team AND match_winner IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS aggregate_losses FROM MatchTeams GROUP BY team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 ORDER BY aggregate_losses DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: Which team has the highest aggregate losses in the shortest matches (by the balls bowled) without ever winning?
question_hindi: सबसे छोटे मैचों (फेंकी गई गेंदों के आधार पर) में बिना एक भी मैच जीते, कुल हार सबसे अधिक किस टीम की है?

question_telugu: అన్నిటికన్నా చిన్న మ్యాచులలో (విసిరిన బంతుల ద్వారా) ఏ టీం దగ్గర అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ మొత్తం నష్టాలు ఉన్నాయి? (ఒక గెలుపు కూడా లేకనడ)

question: In T20 world cup history, which match has the highest ratio of wides to total balls bowled, and what is that ratio?

question: Which team had the most no balls while conceding the fewest wides? Also report the opposing team and the No balls to wides ratio
query: SELECT bowling_team, batting_team AS opposing_team, (SUM(noballs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(wides), 0)) AS nb_to_wide_ratio FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, bowling_team, batting_team ORDER BY SUM(noballs) DESC, SUM(wides) ASC LIMIT 1;
question_english: Which team had the most no balls while conceding the fewest wides? Also report the opposing team and the No balls to wides ratio

question: Which team recorded the most leg byes in an innings, how many , against whom, at what venue, and what were their total extras and score?
query: SELECT d.batting_team, SUM(d.legbyes) AS total_legbyes, d.bowling_team AS against_whom, m.venue, SUM(d.extra_runs) AS total_extras, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_score FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team, m.venue ORDER BY total_legbyes DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: Which team recorded the most leg byes in a T20I innings, how many , against whom, at what venue, and what were their total extras and score?
question_hindi: टी20I की एक पारी में सबसे अधिक लेग बाय किस टीम ने दर्ज किए, कितने, किसके खिलाफ, किस मैदान पर, और उनके कुल एक्स्ट्रा तथा स्कोर क्या थे?
question_punjabi: ਕਿਸ ਟੀਮ ਨੇ ਇੱਕ ਪਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ Leg Bye ਦਰਜ ਕੀਤੇ, ਕਿੰਨੇ, ਕਿਸ ਦੇ ਖਿਲਾਫ਼, ਕਿਸ ਮੈਦਾਨ 'ਤੇ, ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਕੁੱਲ ਵਾਧੂ ਰਨ ਅਤੇ ਸਕੋਰ ਕੀ ਸੀ?
question_telugu: ఒక T20I ఇన్నింగ్స్లో ఏ టీం అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ లెగ్ బై పరుగులు సంపాదించింది? లెగ్ బైల సంఖ్య, వ్యతిరేకమైన టీం, స్థానం, మొత్తం ఎక్స్ట్రా పరుగులు మరియు స్కోర్ రాయండి.

question: Which team recorded 10 leg byes while scoring just 92 runs in 20 overs against Oman — name the team, venue, and their run rate?
query: SELECT d.batting_team, m.venue, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS run_rate FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.bowling_team = 'Oman' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team, m.venue HAVING SUM(d.legbyes) = 10 AND SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) = 92;
question_english: Which team recorded 10 leg byes while scoring just 92 runs in 20 overs against Oman — name the team, venue, and their run rate?
question_hindi: ओमान के खिलाफ 20 ओवर में सिर्फ 92 रन बनाते हुए 10 लेग बाय दर्ज करने वाली टीम कौन थी — टीम, मैदान और उनका रन रेट बताइए।
question_punjabi: ਕਿਹੜੀ ਟੀਮ ਨੇ Oman ਦੇ ਖਿਲਾਫ਼ 20 ਓਵਰਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਿਰਫ਼ 92 ਰਨ ਬਣਾਉਂਦੇ ਹੋਏ 10 ਲੈੱਗ ਬਾਈ ਦਰਜ ਕੀਤੇ — ਉਸ ਟੀਮ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ, ਮੈਦਾਨ ਅਤੇ ਰਨ ਰੇਟ ਦੱਸੋ?
question_telugu: ఏ టీం 10 లెగ్ బైలు సంపాదిస్తూ 20 ఓవర్లలో ఒమాన్ కి వ్యతిరేకంగా కేవలం 92 పరుగులు సంపాదించింది? టీం, స్థానం మరియు రన్ రేట్ రాయండి.

question: In T20I career batting history, which Indian batter has the highest strike rate among all Indian players with 3000+ runs. Report the Strike rate, average, and total sixes?
query: SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS strike_rate, (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS average, SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_sixes FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE d.batting_team = 'India' GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 3000 ORDER BY strike_rate DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: In T20I career batting history, which Indian batter has the highest strike rate among all Indian players with 3000+ runs. Report the Strike rate, average, and total sixes?
question_hindi: टी20I करियर बल्लेबाज़ी इतिहास में, 3000 से अधिक रन वाले सभी भारतीय खिलाड़ियों में सबसे अधिक स्ट्राइक रेट किस भारतीय बल्लेबाज़ का है? उसका स्ट्राइक रेट, औसत और कुल छक्के बताइए।

question_telugu: T20I బ్యాటింగ్ ఇతిహాసలో 3000+ పరుగులు సంపాదించిన భారతీయ క్రీడాకార్లలో ఎవరి దగ్గర అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ స్ట్రైక్ రేట్ ఉన్నది? స్ట్రైక్ రేట్, ఒక మ్యాచ్లో ఆవెరేజ్ పరుగులు మరియు సిక్సుల సంఖ్య రాయండి.

question: Among all players with 29 (50+ scores), which has the highest SR, name all four players, their countries, and also give their SR
query: WITH BattingStats AS (SELECT striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs, COUNT(delivery_id) - SUM(CASE WHEN wides > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id), InningsScores AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, inning, SUM(runs_scored) AS innings_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id, inning), FiftyPlusCounts AS (SELECT striker_id, COUNT(*) AS fifty_plus_scores FROM InningsScores WHERE innings_runs >= 50 GROUP BY striker_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 29) SELECT p.player_name AS Player, (SELECT team_name FROM PlayerInMatch WHERE player_id = p.player_id LIMIT 1) AS Country, fpc.fifty_plus_scores, ROUND(CAST(bs.total_runs AS FLOAT) / bs.balls_faced * 100, 2) AS SR FROM FiftyPlusCounts fpc JOIN Players p ON fpc.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN BattingStats bs ON fpc.striker_id = bs.striker_id ORDER BY SR DESC;
question_english: Among all players with 29 (50+ scores), which has the highest SR, name all four players, their countries, and also give their SR
question_hindi: 29 (50+ स्कोर) वाले सभी खिलाड़ियों में सबसे अधिक SR किसका है, सभी चार खिलाड़ियों के नाम, उनके देश, और उनका SR भी बताइए।
question_punjabi: 29 (50+ ਸਕੋਰ) ਵਾਲੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਸਦੀ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ SR ਹੈ, ਸਾਰੇ ਚਾਰ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਦੇਸ਼, ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ SR ਵੀ ਦੱਸੋ?

question: In T20I history, which player has the most sixes among all players with 30+ fifty-plus scores , average, and ducks?
query: WITH PlayerMatchStats AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS match_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_sixes, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id) SELECT p.player_name, SUM(pms.match_sixes) AS total_sixes, (SUM(pms.match_runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pms.is_out), 0)) AS average, SUM(CASE WHEN pms.match_runs = 0 AND pms.is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_ducks FROM PlayerMatchStats pms JOIN Players p ON pms.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY pms.striker_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN pms.match_runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 30 ORDER BY total_sixes DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: In T20I history, which player has the most sixes among all players with 30+ fifty-plus scores , average, and ducks?
question_hindi: टी20I इतिहास में, 30 या उससे अधिक 50+ स्कोर वाले खिलाड़ियों में सबसे अधिक छक्के किस खिलाड़ी ने लगाए हैं, साथ ही उसका औसत और डक भी बताइए।
question_punjabi: T20I ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ, 30 ਜਾਂ ਵੱਧ ਅਰਧ-ਸੈਂਕੜੇ ਵਾਲੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਸਨੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਛੱਕੇ ਮਾਰੇ ਹਨ, ਉਸਦੀ ਔਸਤ ਅਤੇ ਡੱਕ ਵੀ ਦੱਸੋ?
question_telugu: T20I ఇతిహాసలో 30+ యాభై కన్నా ఎక్కువ స్కోర్ ఉన్న క్రీడాకార్లలో ఎవరి దగ్గర అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ సిక్సులు ఉన్నాయి? అతన ఆవెరేజ్ మరియు డక్కూల సంఖ్య రాయండి.

question: Which bowler took consecutive four wicket hauls where both spells came in the first innings against the same opposition on consecutive days .Report his country, ratio of wickets to runs conceded, and opponents?
query: WITH BowlerStats AS (SELECT d.match_id, m.match_date, d.bowler_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS runs_conceded FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.inning = 1 GROUP BY d.match_id, m.match_date, d.bowler_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4) SELECT p.player_name, b1.bowling_team AS country, ((b1.wickets + b2.wickets) * 1.0 / NULLIF((b1.runs_conceded + b2.runs_conceded), 0)) AS wicket_to_runs_ratio, b1.batting_team AS opponents FROM BowlerStats b1 JOIN BowlerStats b2 ON b1.bowler_id = b2.bowler_id AND b1.batting_team = b2.batting_team AND date(b2.match_date) = date(b1.match_date, '+1 day') JOIN Players p ON b1.bowler_id = p.player_id;
question_english: Which bowler took consecutive four wicket hauls where both spells came in the first innings against the same opposition on consecutive days .Report his country, ratio of wickets to runs conceded, and opponents?
question_hindi: किस गेंदबाज़ ने लगातार चार-चार विकेट वाले स्पेल लिए, जहाँ दोनों स्पेल पहली पारी में, उसी विपक्ष के खिलाफ, लगातार दिनों में आए? उसका देश, लिए गए विकेट और दिए गए रन का अनुपात, तथा विपक्षी टीम बताइए।
question_punjabi: ਕਿਸ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ ਨੇ ਲਗਾਤਾਰ ਦੋ ਦਿਨਾਂ 'ਤੇ ਇੱਕੋ ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ ਦੇ ਖਿਲਾਫ਼ ਪਹਿਲੀ ਪਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਲਗਾਤਾਰ ਚਾਰ ਵਿਕਟ ਹਾਲ ਲਏ? ਉਸਦਾ ਦੇਸ਼, ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਦਿੱਤੇ ਰਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਅਨੁਪਾਤ, ਅਤੇ ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਦੱਸੋ?
question_telugu: ఏ బౌలర్ వరుసగా 4 వికెట్లు తీసుకున్నాడు? రెండు స్పెల్స్ ఒకే టీం కి వ్యతిరేకంగా వరుస రోజుల్లో మొదటి ఇన్నింగ్స్లో వచ్చాయి. అతన దేశం, వికెట్లు/ఇచ్చిన పరుగుల రేషియో మరియు వ్యతిరేకమైన టీం రాయండి.

question: In T20I career bowling history, which spinner has bowled the most balls despite never taking a five-wicket haul, name his country, wickets, economy?
query: WITH MatchWickets AS (SELECT match_id, bowler_id, bowling_team, SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_wkts, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_balls, SUM(runs_scored + wides + noballs) AS match_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, bowler_id, bowling_team) SELECT p.player_name, MAX(mw.bowling_team) AS country, SUM(mw.match_wkts) AS wickets, (SUM(mw.match_runs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(mw.match_balls), 0)) AS economy FROM MatchWickets mw JOIN Players p ON mw.bowler_id = p.player_id GROUP BY mw.bowler_id, p.player_name HAVING MAX(mw.match_wkts) < 5 ORDER BY SUM(mw.match_balls) DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: In T20I career bowling history, which spinner has bowled the most balls despite never taking a five-wicket haul, name his country, wickets, economy?
question_hindi: टी20I करियर गेंदबाज़ी इतिहास में, पांच विकेट हॉल कभी न लेने के बावजूद सबसे अधिक गेंदें किस स्पिनर ने फेंकी हैं, उसका देश, विकेट और इकॉनमी बताइए।
question_punjabi: T20I ਕਰੀਅਰ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ, ਕਿਹੜੇ ਸਪਿਨਰ ਨੇ ਕਦੇ ਪੰਜ ਵਿਕਟ ਹਾਲ ਨਾ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਹੋਏ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਗੇਂਦਾਂ ਸੁੱਟੀਆਂ ਹਨ, ਉਸਦਾ ਦੇਸ਼, ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਇਕਾਨਮੀ ਦੱਸੋ?
question_telugu: T20I బౌలింగ్ ఇతిహాసలో ఏ స్పిన్నర్ ఒక ఇన్నింగ్స్లో 5 వికెట్లు తీసుకోకుండా అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ బంతులు విసిరాడు? అతన దేశం, వికెట్ల సంఖ్య మరియు ఎకానమీ రాయండి.

question: Which Bangladeshi bowler has taken the most five-wicket hauls with 2700+ balls. Report his economy, wickets, and how many five-wicket hauls does he have
query: WITH BowlerMatchStats AS (SELECT bowler_id, match_id, SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_wkts, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_balls, SUM(runs_scored + wides + noballs) AS match_runs FROM Deliveries WHERE bowling_team = 'Bangladesh' GROUP BY bowler_id, match_id) SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(bms.match_runs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(bms.match_balls), 0)) AS economy, SUM(bms.match_wkts) AS wickets, SUM(CASE WHEN bms.match_wkts >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS five_wicket_hauls FROM BowlerMatchStats bms JOIN Players p ON bms.bowler_id = p.player_id GROUP BY bms.bowler_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(bms.match_balls) >= 2700 ORDER BY five_wicket_hauls DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: Which Bangladeshi bowler has taken the most five-wicket hauls with 2700+ balls. Report his economy, wickets, and how many five-wicket hauls does he have?

question: New Zealand and India tied in T20Is on consecutive days. Give the dates and venues of the matches.
query: WITH NZ_IND_Ties AS (SELECT match_date, venue FROM Matches WHERE ((team1 = 'New Zealand' AND team2 = 'India') OR (team1 = 'India' AND team2 = 'New Zealand')) AND result_type = 'tie') SELECT t1.match_date AS date1, t1.venue AS venue1, t2.match_date AS date2, t2.venue AS venue2 FROM NZ_IND_Ties t1 JOIN NZ_IND_Ties t2 ON date(t2.match_date) = date(t1.match_date, '+2 day');
question_english: New Zealand and India tied in T20Is on consecutive days. Give the dates and venues of the matches.

question: In T20I history, which team chased the highest ever target on the last ball.Give their name their target, opponents, margin of victory, and date?
query: WITH InningStats AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team) SELECT i2.batting_team AS team_name, (i1.total_runs + 1) AS target, i2.bowling_team AS opponents, m.result_margin, m.match_date FROM InningStats i1 JOIN InningStats i2 ON i1.match_id = i2.match_id AND i1.inning = 1 AND i2.inning = 2 JOIN Matches m ON i1.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner = i2.batting_team AND i2.legal_balls = 120 ORDER BY target DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: In T20I history, which team chased the highest ever target on the last ball.Give their name their target, opponents, margin of victory, and date?

question: Name the only last-ball T20I win completed in just 5 overs. State the winner, opposition, target and margin?
query: WITH MatchLengths AS (SELECT match_id, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls_inn2 FROM Deliveries WHERE inning = 2 GROUP BY match_id), FirstInningScore AS (SELECT match_id, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS inn1_runs FROM Deliveries WHERE inning = 1 GROUP BY match_id) SELECT m.match_winner AS winner, CASE WHEN m.team1 = m.match_winner THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opposition, f.inn1_runs + 1 AS target, m.result_margin || ' ' || m.result_type AS margin, m.match_date FROM Matches m JOIN MatchLengths ml ON m.match_id = ml.match_id JOIN FirstInningScore f ON m.match_id = f.match_id WHERE ml.legal_balls_inn2 = 30 AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND m.result_type = 'wickets' ORDER BY m.match_date DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which team holds the highest ever batting average per wicket in T20I history, name their score, opposition, date and batting average?
query: WITH InningsStats AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'retired not out') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_lost FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team) SELECT i.batting_team AS team, i.total_runs || '/' || i.wickets_lost AS score, i.bowling_team AS opposition, m.match_date AS date, ROUND(CAST(i.total_runs AS FLOAT) / CASE WHEN i.wickets_lost = 0 THEN 1 ELSE i.wickets_lost END, 2) AS batting_average FROM InningsStats i JOIN Matches m ON i.match_id = m.match_id ORDER BY batting_average DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Canada appears twice in highest batting average records. Name both opponents, averages and scores?

question: Which team achieved an average of 200 in T20I history in just 14.1 overs. Name their opposition and score

question: Which team achieved the highest average per wicket in fewer than 9 overs in T20I history. Give the name of the team, average, overs, opposition, and date?
query: SELECT d.batting_team AS team_name, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS average, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 6.0) AS overs, d.bowling_team AS opposition, m.match_date AS date FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team, m.match_date HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 54 ORDER BY average DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Three teams scored 258 runs in 20 overs with identical run rates of 12.90 — name both teams, their wickets lost, opponents

question: In T20I history, which team achieved a run rate of 15.70 scoring 314 runs — name their opposition, wickets lost, and date?

question: Which team holds the lowest ever innings total in T20I history, name their score, opposition, overs faced, and run rate?
query: SELECT d.batting_team, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS score, d.bowling_team AS opposition, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 6.0) AS overs_faced, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS run_rate FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team ORDER BY score ASC LIMIT 1;

question: Two teams have been dismissed for exactly 10 runs in T20I history — name both teams, their opponents, overs faced, and innings numbers?
query: SELECT d.batting_team, d.bowling_team AS opponents, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 6.0) AS overs_faced, d.inning AS innings_number FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) = 10;

question: Turkey suffered three extremely low T20I totals at the same venue on three consecutive days — name all three opponents, scores, innings numbers, and dates?

question: China suffered back-to-back extremely low T20I totals against different opponents on consecutive days at the same venue. Give both scores, opponents, venue, and dates?

question: Among all players with 14 POTM awards, which has the best award-to-match ratio — name all four players, their matches played, and calculate ratio for each?
query: WITH POTM_Counts AS (SELECT player_of_match_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS potm_count FROM Matches WHERE player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_of_match_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 14), Match_Counts AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS matches_played FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id) SELECT p.player_name, mc.matches_played, (pc.potm_count * 1.0 / mc.matches_played) AS award_to_match_ratio FROM POTM_Counts pc JOIN Match_Counts mc ON pc.player_id = mc.player_id JOIN Players p ON pc.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY award_to_match_ratio DESC LIMIT 4;
question_english: Among all players with 14 POTM awards, which has the best award-to-match ratio — name all four players, their matches played, and calculate ratio for each

question_telugu: 14 'ప్లేయర్ ఆఫ్ తే మ్యాచ్' అవార్డ్లు ఉన్న క్రీడాకార్లలో ఎవరి దగ్గర అన్నిటికన్నా మంచి అవార్డ్ల సంఖ్య/మ్యాచుల సంఖ్య రేషియో ఉన్నది? క్రీడాకార్ల పేరు, మ్యాచుల సంఖ్య మరియు రేషియోలు రాయండి.

question: V Kohli and RG Sharma both have 14+ POTM awards. Give their awards, matches, spans, and award-to-match ratios
query: WITH MatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, COUNT(pim.match_id) AS matches_played, MIN(m.match_date) || ' to ' || MAX(m.match_date) AS span FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY pim.player_id), POTMStats AS (SELECT player_of_match_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS potm_awards FROM Matches WHERE player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_of_match_id) SELECT p.player_name, ps.potm_awards, ms.matches_played, ms.span, (ps.potm_awards * 1.0 / ms.matches_played) AS award_to_match_ratio FROM Players p JOIN MatchStats ms ON p.player_id = ms.player_id JOIN POTMStats ps ON p.player_id = ps.player_id WHERE p.player_name IN ('V Kohli', 'RG Sharma') ORDER BY ps.potm_awards DESC;
question_english: V Kohli and RG Sharma both have 14+ POTM awards. Give their awards, matches, spans, and award-to-match ratios
question_hindi: वी कोहली और आरजी शर्मा दोनों के पास 14 या उससे अधिक POTM अवॉर्ड हैं। उनके अवॉर्ड, मैच, करियर स्पैन, और अवॉर्ड-प्रति-मैच अनुपात बताइए।
question_punjabi: Virat Kohli ਅਤੇ RG Sharma ਦੋਵਾਂ ਕੋਲ 14 ਜਾਂ ਵੱਧ POTM ਅਵਾਰਡ ਹਨ। ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਅਵਾਰਡ, ਮੈਚ, ਸਮਾਂ-ਕਾਲ ਅਤੇ ਅਵਾਰਡ-ਤੋਂ-ਮੈਚ ਅਨੁਪਾਤ ਦੱਸੋ?
question_telugu: V Kohli మరియు RG Sharma దగ్గర 14+ 'ప్లేయర్ ఆఫ్ తే మ్యాచ్' అవార్డ్లు ఉన్నాయి. వాళ్ళ అవార్డ్ల సంఖ్య, మ్యాచుల సంఖ్య, ఆడిన సంవత్సరాలు మరియు అవార్డ్ల సంఖ్య/మ్యాచుల సంఖ్య రేషియోలు రాయబడి.

question: Which player has won 8 POTM awards in the fewest matches in T20I history — name his country, span, and award ratio?
query: WITH MatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, MAX(pim.team_name) AS country, COUNT(pim.match_id) AS matches_played, MIN(m.match_date) || ' to ' || MAX(m.match_date) AS span FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY pim.player_id), POTMStats AS (SELECT player_of_match_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS potm_awards FROM Matches WHERE player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_of_match_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 8) SELECT p.player_name, ms.country, ms.span, (ps.potm_awards * 1.0 / ms.matches_played) AS award_ratio FROM POTMStats ps JOIN MatchStats ms ON ps.player_id = ms.player_id JOIN Players p ON ps.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY ms.matches_played ASC LIMIT 1;
question_english: Which player has won 8 POTM awards in the fewest matches in T20I history — name his country, span, and award ratio?

question: Which T20I match holds the record for the most batters dismissed lbw, name both teams, total lbw count, total wickets in the match, winner, and date?
query: SELECT m.team1, m.team2, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type = 'lbw' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_lbw_count, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_wickets, m.match_winner, m.match_date FROM Matches m JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id GROUP BY m.match_id, m.team1, m.team2, m.match_winner, m.match_date ORDER BY total_lbw_count DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: Which T20I match holds the record for the most batters dismissed lbw, name both teams, total lbw count, total wickets in the match, winner, and date?

question: The only T20I match with 7 lbw dismissals that ended in a tie — name both teams, total wickets, venue, and date?

question: Which bowler reached 50 T20I wickets in the fewest matches . Report the name of his country, number of matches that took him to achieve it, the date he achieved it, and calculate exactly how many days it took him?
query: WITH BowlerMatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, pim.team_name AS country, m.match_id, m.match_date, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id LEFT JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.player_id = d.bowler_id GROUP BY pim.player_id, pim.team_name, m.match_id, m.match_date), RunningStats AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS match_number, SUM(wickets) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS cumulative_wickets, MIN(match_date) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id) AS debut_date FROM BowlerMatchStats), Milestone AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_number, match_date, debut_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_number ASC) as rn FROM RunningStats WHERE cumulative_wickets >= 50) SELECT p.player_name, m.country, m.match_number, m.match_date, CAST(julianday(m.match_date) - julianday(m.debut_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_taken FROM Milestone m JOIN Players p ON m.player_id = p.player_id WHERE m.rn = 1 ORDER BY m.match_number ASC LIMIT 1;

question: Among all players with 5 T20I career hundreds, compare GJ Maxwell and RG Sharma across innings played, average, SR, sixes, and ducks
query: WITH BatterMatch AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_scored, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sixes FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id), Dismissals AS (SELECT player_out_id AS player_id, match_id, 1 AS is_out FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(bm.match_id) AS innings_played, (SUM(bm.runs_scored) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(dm.is_out), 0)) AS average, (SUM(bm.runs_scored) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(bm.balls_faced), 0)) AS sr, SUM(bm.sixes) AS sixes, SUM(CASE WHEN bm.runs_scored = 0 AND dm.is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ducks FROM BatterMatch bm JOIN Players p ON bm.player_id = p.player_id LEFT JOIN Dismissals dm ON bm.player_id = dm.player_id AND bm.match_id = dm.match_id WHERE p.player_name IN ('GJ Maxwell', 'RG Sharma') GROUP BY bm.player_id, p.player_name;

question: Abhishek Sharma has the highest career SR among all players with 2 hundreds . Give his strike rate, hundreds, average, and calculate how many balls he faces per hundred on average?
query: WITH BatterInnings AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_scored, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, CASE WHEN SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_hundred FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Abhishek Sharma' GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning), CareerStats AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(balls_faced) AS total_balls, SUM(is_hundred) AS total_hundreds FROM BatterInnings GROUP BY player_id), Dismissals AS (SELECT player_out_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS total_dismissals FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.player_out_id = p.player_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Abhishek Sharma' GROUP BY d.player_out_id) SELECT p.player_name, (c.total_runs * 100.0 / NULLIF(c.total_balls, 0)) AS strike_rate, c.total_hundreds AS hundreds, (c.total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(d.total_dismissals, 0)) AS average, (c.total_balls * 1.0 / NULLIF(c.total_hundreds, 0)) AS balls_per_hundred FROM CareerStats c JOIN Players p ON c.player_id = p.player_id LEFT JOIN Dismissals d ON c.player_id = d.player_id;
question_english: Abhishek Sharma has the highest career SR among all players with 2 hundreds . Give his strike rate, hundreds, average, and calculate how many balls he faces per hundred on average?

question: Two teams suffered 4 stumpings in a single innings in T20I history — name both teams, their scores and opposition

question_punjabi: T20I ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੋ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਨੇ ਇੱਕੋ ਪਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ 4 ਸਟੰਪਿੰਗ ਝੱਲੀਆਂ — ਦੋਵੇਂ ਟੀਮਾਂ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਸਕੋਰ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਦੱਸੋ?

question: Australia scored 197/7 with 3 stumpings and still won . Name the opposition, venue, date, and calculate what percentage of their wickets were stumpings?
query: SELECT d.bowling_team AS opposition, m.venue, m.match_date, d.inning AS innings_number, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type = 'stumped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS stumping_percentage FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.batting_team = 'Australia' AND m.match_winner = 'Australia' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team, m.venue, m.match_date HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) = 197 AND SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 7 AND SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type = 'stumped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 3;
question_english: Australia scored 197/7 with 3 stumpings and still won . Name the opposition, venue, date, and calculate what percentage of their wickets were stumpings?
question_hindi: ऑस्ट्रेलिया ने 197/7 बनाकर 3 स्टंपिंग झेलीं और फिर भी जीत गया। विपक्षी टीम, स्थल, तारीख, और उनके कितने प्रतिशत विकेट स्टंपिंग थे, बताइए।

question: Samoa suffered 3 stumpings scoring 148/8 yet still lost. Name the opposition, venue, date ?

question: List all players who batted in Innings 2 and scored 70+ runs on debut. Give names, teams, and scores.
query: SELECT p.player_name, pd.team_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN (SELECT pim.player_id, pim.match_id, pim.team_name FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_date = (SELECT MIN(m2.match_date) FROM PlayerInMatch pim2 JOIN Matches m2 ON pim2.match_id = m2.match_id WHERE pim2.player_id = pim.player_id)) pd ON d.match_id = pd.match_id AND d.striker_id = pd.player_id JOIN Players p ON pd.player_id = p.player_id WHERE d.inning = 2 GROUP BY p.player_id HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 70;
question_english: List all players who batted in Innings 2 and scored 70+ runs on debut. Give names, teams, and scores.

question: Spain have won two T20I matches by 1 wicket in their history. Name both matches with targets, opposition, grounds, and dates.

question_punjabi: Spain ਨੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ 1 ਵਿਕਟ ਨਾਲ ਦੋ T20I ਮੈਚ ਜਿੱਤੇ ਹਨ। ਦੋਵੇਂ ਮੈਚਾਂ ਦੇ ਟੀਚੇ, ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮਾਂ, ਮੈਦਾਨ ਅਤੇ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਦੱਸੋ?

question: Which match had the highest number of no-balls ever recorded in a T20I? Name the teams, ground, date, and calculate what percentage of total extras in that match were no-balls alone.
query: SELECT m.team1, m.team2, m.venue AS ground, m.match_date AS date, SUM(d.noballs) AS total_noballs, (SUM(d.noballs) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(d.extra_runs), 0)) AS noball_percentage FROM Matches m JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id GROUP BY m.match_id, m.team1, m.team2, m.venue, m.match_date ORDER BY total_noballs DESC LIMIT 1;

question: List the top 3 T20I matches with the highest no-balls per over ratio. Name both the teams and give the corresponding ratio as well.

question: Among the top 5 run-scorers in T20I history, give the strike rate , the average runs per innings for each, and rank them by batting average.
query: WITH BatterStats AS (SELECT d.striker_id, p.player_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS innings_played FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name), Top5Batters AS (SELECT * FROM BatterStats ORDER BY total_runs DESC LIMIT 5), Dismissals AS (SELECT player_out_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS times_out FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_out_id) SELECT t.player_name, (t.total_runs * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.balls_faced, 0)) AS strike_rate, (t.total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.innings_played, 0)) AS avg_runs_per_innings, (t.total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(d.times_out, 0)) AS batting_average FROM Top5Batters t LEFT JOIN Dismissals d ON t.striker_id = d.player_id ORDER BY batting_average DESC;
question_english: Among the top 5 run-scorers in T20I history, give the strike rate , the average runs per innings for each, and rank them by batting average.
question_hindi: टी20I इतिहास के शीर्ष 5 रन-स्कोररों के लिए स्ट्राइक रेट, प्रति पारी औसत रन बताइए, और उन्हें बल्लेबाजी औसत के आधार पर रैंक कीजिए।

question: Babar Azam leads all T20I run-scorers with 4596 runs. Give his runs per match ratio and what percentage of his runs came in boundaries
query: SELECT (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Players p2 ON pim.player_id = p2.player_id WHERE p2.player_name = 'Babar Azam')) AS runs_per_match_ratio, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored IN (4, 6) THEN d.runs_scored ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(d.runs_scored)) AS boundary_percentage FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Babar Azam';

question_punjabi: Babar Azam 4596 ਰਨਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਸਾਰੇ T20I ਰਨ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਵਾਲਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਅੱਗੇ ਹੈ। ਉਸਦਾ ਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਮੈਚ ਅਨੁਪਾਤ ਦੱਸੋ ਅਤੇ ਉਸਦੇ ਕਿੰਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤ ਰਨ ਬਾਊਂਡਰੀਆਂ ਤੋਂ ਆਏ?

question: List the top 5 players by catches per innings ratio also give the respective ratios.
query: WITH Catches AS (SELECT fd.fielder_id, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS total_catches FROM FielderDismissals fd JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE d.wicket_type IN ('caught', 'caught and bowled') GROUP BY fd.fielder_id), InningsPlayed AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS total_innings FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id) SELECT p.player_name, (c.total_catches * 1.0 / NULLIF(i.total_innings, 0)) AS catches_per_innings_ratio FROM Catches c JOIN InningsPlayed i ON c.fielder_id = i.player_id JOIN Players p ON c.fielder_id = p.player_id ORDER BY catches_per_innings_ratio DESC LIMIT 5;
question_english: List the top 5 players by catches per innings ratio also give the respective ratios.

question: Who scored the most runs off a single over in T20I history, and how many runs were scored? Also name the bowler and the match.

question_punjabi: T20I ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਇੱਕੋ ਓਵਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਰਨ ਕਿਸਨੇ ਬਣਾਏ, ਅਤੇ ਕਿੰਨੇ ਰਨ ਬਣਾਏ? ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ ਅਤੇ ਮੈਚ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਵੀ ਦੱਸੋ?

question: Dipendra Singh Airee appears twice in the most runs off one over records in T20Is. List both instances with  runs, bowler, match, venue, and date.

question: Which instances in the most runs off one over records in T20Is involved a wicket being taken in the same over? List the player, runs, bowler, match, venue, and date.
query: WITH WicketOvers AS (SELECT DISTINCT match_id, inning, over_number FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT p_striker.player_name AS player, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, p_bowler.player_name AS bowler, m.team1 || ' vs ' || m.team2 AS match, m.venue, m.match_date AS date FROM Deliveries d JOIN WicketOvers wo ON d.match_id = wo.match_id AND d.inning = wo.inning AND d.over_number = wo.over_number JOIN Players p_striker ON d.striker_id = p_striker.player_id JOIN Players p_bowler ON d.bowler_id = p_bowler.player_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.over_number, d.striker_id, d.bowler_id, p_striker.player_name, p_bowler.player_name, m.team1, m.team2, m.venue, m.match_date ORDER BY runs DESC;

question: What is the shortest completed innings in T20I history by balls? Give the team, score, balls, run rate, opposition.

question: For each player who carried the bat through a completed T20I innings, calculate their runs as a percentage of the team total.
query: WITH FirstDel AS (SELECT match_id, inning, MIN(delivery_id) AS min_del FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning), Openers AS (SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries d JOIN FirstDel fd ON d.delivery_id = fd.min_del UNION SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.non_striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries d JOIN FirstDel fd ON d.delivery_id = fd.min_del), MatchStats AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS team_total, SUM(CASE WHEN player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'retired not out') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team), BatterStats AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, striker_id) SELECT p.player_name, bs.runs, ms.team_total, (bs.runs * 100.0 / ms.team_total) AS percentage_of_team_total, ms.bowling_team AS opposition, m.match_date FROM BatterStats bs JOIN Openers o ON bs.match_id = o.match_id AND bs.inning = o.inning AND bs.striker_id = o.player_id JOIN MatchStats ms ON bs.match_id = ms.match_id AND bs.inning = ms.inning JOIN Matches m ON bs.match_id = m.match_id JOIN Players p ON bs.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE ms.wickets = 10 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Deliveries out_d WHERE out_d.match_id = bs.match_id AND out_d.inning = bs.inning AND out_d.player_out_id = bs.striker_id) ORDER BY percentage_of_team_total DESC;

question: CG Williams of Namibia scored fifties in 4 consecutive T20I innings. List all four innings with runs, team name, opposition, and venue
query: WITH PlayerAllInnings AS (SELECT p.player_name, m.match_date, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, d.batting_team AS team_name, d.bowling_team AS opposition, m.venue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY m.match_date) AS inning_seq FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE p.player_name = 'CG Williams' GROUP BY p.player_name, d.match_id, m.match_date, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team, m.venue), FiftyInnings AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY match_date) AS fifty_seq FROM PlayerAllInnings WHERE runs >= 50), StreakGroups AS (SELECT *, (inning_seq - fifty_seq) AS streak_id FROM FiftyInnings), ValidStreaks AS (SELECT streak_id FROM StreakGroups GROUP BY streak_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4) SELECT sg.player_name, sg.runs, sg.team_name, sg.opposition, sg.venue FROM StreakGroups sg JOIN ValidStreaks vs ON sg.streak_id = vs.streak_id ORDER BY sg.match_date LIMIT 4;

question: Which player holds the highest batting average in T20I career among players who have played 100 or more T20I matches? Give number of matches, runs, average, and span.
query: WITH MatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) AS matches_played, MIN(m.match_date) || ' to ' || MAX(m.match_date) AS span FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY pim.player_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) >= 100), BattingStats AS (SELECT striker_id AS player_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id), DismissalStats AS (SELECT player_out_id AS player_id, COUNT(delivery_id) AS dismissals FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'retired not out') GROUP BY player_out_id) SELECT p.player_name, ms.matches_played AS matches, COALESCE(bs.total_runs, 0) AS runs, ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(bs.total_runs, 0) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COALESCE(ds.dismissals, 0), 0), 2) AS average, ms.span FROM MatchStats ms JOIN Players p ON ms.player_id = p.player_id LEFT JOIN BattingStats bs ON ms.player_id = bs.player_id LEFT JOIN DismissalStats ds ON ms.player_id = ds.player_id ORDER BY average DESC LIMIT 1;

question: In T20Is, which team posted the highest score despite having 4 or more batsmen run out in a single innings and still lost the match? Return the team, score, opposition.
query: WITH InningScores AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_score, SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type = 'run out' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS run_outs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team) SELECT i.batting_team AS team, i.total_score AS score, i.bowling_team AS opposition FROM InningScores i JOIN Matches m ON i.match_id = m.match_id WHERE i.run_outs >= 4 AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND i.batting_team != m.match_winner ORDER BY i.total_score DESC LIMIT 1;

question: In T20Is, what is the only instance where a team had 7 batsmen run out in a single innings? Return the team, score, result, opposition, and year.
query: WITH InningStats AS (SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_score, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type = 'run out' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS run_outs FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team) SELECT i.batting_team AS team, i.total_score AS score, CASE WHEN m.match_winner = i.batting_team THEN 'Won' WHEN m.match_winner IS NULL THEN 'No Result' ELSE 'Lost' END AS result, i.bowling_team AS opposition, strftime('%Y', m.match_date) AS year FROM InningStats i JOIN Matches m ON i.match_id = m.match_id WHERE i.run_outs = 7;

question: In T20Is, which match holds the record for the highest match aggregate, and what was the run rate of that match?
query: WITH MatchAggregates AS (SELECT match_id, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id) SELECT m.team1, m.team2, m.match_date, ma.total_runs AS match_aggregate, ROUND(ma.total_runs * 6.0 / ma.legal_balls, 2) AS run_rate FROM MatchAggregates ma JOIN Matches m ON ma.match_id = m.match_id ORDER BY ma.total_runs DESC LIMIT 1;

question: In T20Is, which bowler-batter combination has the most dismissals, and what is the batter's average against that bowler?
query: WITH BowlerBatterStats AS (SELECT d.bowler_id, d.striker_id AS batter_id, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissals FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.bowler_id, d.striker_id) SELECT pb.player_name AS bowler, pb2.player_name AS batter, bbs.dismissals, ROUND(CAST(bbs.runs AS FLOAT) / bbs.dismissals, 2) AS batting_average FROM BowlerBatterStats bbs JOIN Players pb ON bbs.bowler_id = pb.player_id JOIN Players pb2 ON bbs.batter_id = pb2.player_id WHERE bbs.dismissals > 0 ORDER BY bbs.dismissals DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: In T20Is, which bowler-batter combination has the most dismissals, and what is the batter's average against that bowler?
question_hindi: टी20I में, किस गेंदबाज़-बल्लेबाज़ संयोजन में सबसे अधिक बार आउट होने की घटना हुई है, और उस गेंदबाज़ के खिलाफ बल्लेबाज़ का औसत क्या है?

question: In T20Is, which bowler has dismissed two different batters 5 or more times each? Return the bowler, both batters, and the respective wicket counts.
query: WITH BowlerBatterDismissals AS (SELECT d.bowler_id, d.player_out_id AS batter_id, COUNT(*) AS dismissals FROM Deliveries d WHERE d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') GROUP BY d.bowler_id, d.player_out_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5), BowlersWithTwo AS (SELECT bowler_id FROM BowlerBatterDismissals GROUP BY bowler_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) SELECT pb.player_name AS bowler, pb2.player_name AS batter, bbd.dismissals FROM BowlerBatterDismissals bbd JOIN BowlersWithTwo bwt ON bbd.bowler_id = bwt.bowler_id JOIN Players pb ON bbd.bowler_id = pb.player_id JOIN Players pb2 ON bbd.batter_id = pb2.player_id ORDER BY pb.player_name, bbd.dismissals DESC;
question_english: In T20Is, which bowler has dismissed two different batters 5 or more times each? Return the bowler, both batters, and the respective wicket counts.

question: In T20Is, what is the highest partnership recorded for Japan, and which wicket was it for?
query: WITH DeliveryWithWicketsBefore AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, striker_id, non_striker_id, delivery_id, runs_scored + extra_runs AS ball_runs, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'retired not out') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, inning ORDER BY delivery_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS wickets_before FROM Deliveries), Partnerships AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, wickets_before, SUM(ball_runs) AS partnership_runs, MIN(delivery_id) AS start_id FROM DeliveryWithWicketsBefore GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, wickets_before) SELECT p1.player_name || ' & ' || p2.player_name AS partners, ps.partnership_runs AS runs, (ps.wickets_before + 1) AS wicket, m.match_date FROM Partnerships ps JOIN DeliveryWithWicketsBefore dwb ON ps.start_id = dwb.delivery_id JOIN Players p1 ON dwb.striker_id = p1.player_id JOIN Players p2 ON dwb.non_striker_id = p2.player_id JOIN Matches m ON ps.match_id = m.match_id WHERE ps.batting_team = 'Japan' ORDER BY ps.partnership_runs DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: In T20Is, what is the highest partnership recorded for Japan, and which wicket was it for?

question: In T20Is, among players with zero ducks in their career and 30+ innings, who has the highest strike rate? Return the player, team, strike rate, and innings.
query: WITH BatterInnings AS (SELECT striker_id AS player_id, match_id, inning, SUM(runs_scored) AS innings_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS was_dismissed FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id, inning), PlayerStats AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS innings, SUM(innings_runs) AS total_runs, SUM(balls_faced) AS total_balls, SUM(CASE WHEN innings_runs = 0 AND was_dismissed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ducks FROM BatterInnings GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30 AND SUM(CASE WHEN innings_runs = 0 AND was_dismissed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0), PlayerTeam AS (SELECT player_id, team_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id, team_name) SELECT p.player_name, pt.team_name AS team, ROUND(ps.total_runs * 100.0 / ps.total_balls, 2) AS strike_rate, ps.innings FROM PlayerStats ps JOIN Players p ON ps.player_id = p.player_id JOIN PlayerTeam pt ON ps.player_id = pt.player_id AND pt.rn = 1 ORDER BY strike_rate DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: In T20Is, among players with zero ducks in their career and 30+ innings, who has the highest strike rate? Return the player, team, strike rate, and innings.
question_hindi: टी20I में, करियर में शून्य डक और 30 या उससे अधिक पारियां खेलने वाले खिलाड़ियों में सबसे अधिक स्ट्राइक रेट किसका है? खिलाड़ी, टीम, स्ट्राइक रेट और पारियां बताइए।

question: In T20Is, how many times has a team scored 220+ when the opposition used only five bowlers and still lost the match? Return the teams, scores, and oppositions.
query: WITH InningStats AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_score, COUNT(DISTINCT bowler_id) AS bowlers_used FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team) SELECT COUNT(*) OVER() AS grand_total_instances, i.batting_team AS team, i.total_score AS score, i.bowling_team AS opposition, m.match_date FROM InningStats i JOIN Matches m ON i.match_id = m.match_id WHERE i.total_score >= 220 AND i.bowlers_used = 5 AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND i.batting_team != m.match_winner ORDER BY i.total_score DESC;

question: In T20Is, SR Watson scored the highest individual runs on the losing side. What was his score, which team did he represent, and who was the opposition?
